Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly identified the products of the neutralization reaction between Hydrochloric acid (HCl) and Sodium hydroxide (NaOH). A neutralization reaction between a strong acid and a strong base produces a salt and water ($H_2O$), not hydroxide ions ($OH$). The correct reaction is $HCl + NaOH \rightarrow NaCl + H_2O$. The Planner mistakenly selected Option B ($NaCl + OH$) instead of Option D ($NaCl + H_2O$) and concluded the task was complete with the wrong answer.
